READABILITY.evidence: The guards are short and easy to follow, use the existing is_cached API, and carry a clear comment: "Don't override a related object that was already fetched, e.g. by a nested prefetch_related() lookup."

MAINTAINABILITY.evidence: The patch reuses the existing field.is_cached helper and adds no new bookkeeping. But it repeats the same guard and comment in three places, and goes beyond the two-line guard the conventions describe by also changing ForwardManyToOneDescriptor and ReverseOneToOneDescriptor.

ROBUSTNESS.evidence: There are no new exceptions or magic constants. The guard is conditional, so a plain prefetch behaves as before. The agent also reports the select_related identity side effect. Hidden tests pass (P2P 85/85).

C7-05-CASE1.evidence: The reverse-FK path uses `if not self.field.is_cached(rel_obj): setattr(...)`, so the parent is still set when nothing is cached. The one-to-one paths are guarded the same way (`if not self.related.field.is_cached(rel_obj)`), and both variants were tested.
